title: Hugo Montoya
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Missionary to Mexico City North Mission from 1979-1981.
Married Maria del Carmen Balvastro Rubio, April 6, 1983, Mesa Arizona Temple; five children.
Graduated from Sonora State University in 1986 with a degree in Agricultural Engineering.
Xerox, system consulting manager, senior analyst, and payroll manager. CES instructor, 1988-1991. Tortilla shop owner, 1994-2011.
Ward Mission Leader, Stake High Council, Counselor to Stake President, Stake President, Area Auditor, Area Seventy.
First Quorum of the Seventy, 2015 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
